            <title><![CDATA[More than 400,000 protest across France, challenging Macron as Paris clashes erupt]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/more-than-400000-protest-across-france-challenging-macron-as-paris-clashes-erupt</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Clashes erupted in Paris as a mass march drew to a close Saturday, with more than 400,000 people rallying across France over school funding and soaring living costs in a fresh challenge to President Emmanuel Macron.             <description><![CDATA[President Trump is making a final push to help Republicans maintain control of Congress as some of the most closely watched races remain competitive.             <title><![CDATA[News Wrap: White House says Melania Trump brokered localized ceasefire deal in Oleshky]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/news-wrap-white-house-says-melania-trump-brokered-localized-ceasefire-deal-in-oleshky</link>
